proposedEntry.name: review-a11y
proposedEntry.description: Reviews changed frontend code (staged files, a working diff, a branch, or a PR) for WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility using a bundled, install-free static engine with cross-file JSX/TSX AST analysis. Treats engine findings as candidates, not verdicts: confirms each occurrence in the actual code, flags preliminary findings from framework templates or library-rendered markup that need rendered-DOM verification, adjudicates judgment criteria (alt-text relevance, link purpose, focus logic) from visible evidence, and refutes false positives with cited code. Returns a severity-ranked WCAG 2.2 AA review scoped only to the change, with file:line fixes, explicitly named residual rendering risks (contrast, focus visibility, zoom) that require a browser scan, and a pass/fail verdict.
inputs: staged files, a working diff, a branch, or a PR diff
the bundled engine's candidate findings from `node scripts/ultra11y.mjs audit`
outputs: severity-ranked WCAG 2.2 AA review scoped to the change, with file:line fixes
list of residual rendering risks requiring a browser scan
